T: A truck full of beer. Pass the ribs.
D: A bootlegger runs a truckload of beer across state lines with a sheriff chasing him the whole way.
P: Serve the mains when the Bandit picks up Frog by the side of the road.
S: Pork rind dried overnight then roasted until puffed and crackling, broken into shards and dusted with smoked paprika, cayenne and salt, with a ranch dip. Score 600g pork rind in strips, rub well with salt and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Pat dry, lay skin up on a rack and roast at 240C for 30 to 40 minutes until fully puffed and crackling. Break into shards and dust with 1 tsp smoked paprika, half a tsp cayenne and salt. Mix 150g sour cream, 2 tbsp mayo, garlic powder, dill and chives for dip.
Raw peanuts simmered in salty Cajun water, served warm in paper cups
Raw peanuts in the shell boiled 2 hours in heavily salted water with a little Cajun spice, left to soak an hour, served warm in paper cups.
Garlic and dill pickled okra with chilli, served cold with sharp cheddar
Okra packed into jars with garlic, dill and chilli, covered in hot vinegar brine, pickled a week, served cold with sharp cheddar.
M: pork rubbed with paprika and cayenne, tangy vinegar glaze, coleslaw, with 400 cases of beer to haul

Pork ribs rubbed with paprika, brown sugar and cayenne, baked low and slow, glazed with a tangy vinegar barbecue sauce and charred, with crunchy coleslaw. Mix 2 tbsp paprika, 3 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp cayenne and 2 tsp salt and rub over 2kg pork ribs. Wrap in foil and bake at 150C for 2.5 hours. Simmer 125ml cider vinegar, 125ml tomato sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tsp chilli flakes for 5 minutes. Brush on the ribs and grill hot for 5 minutes. Toss half a shredded cabbage and a grated carrot with 125g mayo and vinegar.
Crisp breaded steak under creamy black pepper gravy
Minute steaks pounded thin, dredged in seasoned flour, buttermilk and flour again, fried until crisp, smothered in cracked pepper cream gravy. Mash.
W: Cinnamon peaches under a soft biscuit topping, with vanilla ice cream
Sliced peaches with brown sugar, cinnamon and lemon, covered in buttery biscuit dough, baked at 190C for 40 minutes. Vanilla ice cream.
K: Sweet black tea with peaches and a shot of bourbon over ice

Black tea brewed strong with fresh peach and sugar, chilled, poured over ice with a shot of bourbon, lemon and mint. Leave out the bourbon for the drivers. Brew 5 black tea bags in 1L boiling water with 2 sliced peaches and 100g sugar for 6 minutes. Remove the bags and chill with the peaches in. Fill four tall glasses with ice, add 30ml bourbon to each, then top with the tea. Finish each with a squeeze of lemon, a peach slice and a sprig of mint.

steps.text: Rinse the peanuts well and put them in a large pot with the water, salt and Cajun seasoning.
Simmer with the lid on, topping up with water as needed, until the peanuts are soft.
Turn off the heat and let the peanuts soak in the brine.
Drain and serve warm in paper cups.
Pack the okra into a clean jar with the garlic, dill and chilli.
Boil the vinegar, water and salt together and pour over while hot.
Cool, lid and pickle in the fridge for a week.
Serve cold with the cheddar cut into chunks.

dishes.make_ahead: Mash the potatoes up to 1 day ahead and reheat with a splash of milk; pound the steaks, fry them and make the gravy on the night

steps.text: Peel and boil the potatoes until soft, then mash with the butter and some of the milk. Keep warm.
Pound the steaks thin and season the flour with the salt and plenty of cracked black peppercorns.
Dredge each steak in flour, then buttermilk, then flour again.
Shallow fry in hot oil until deep golden and crisp, then keep warm on a rack.
Whisk the gravy flour into the pan fat, add the remaining milk and lots of cracked pepper and simmer until thick.
Serve the steaks over the mash with the gravy.

veg.make_ahead: Press the mushroom clusters and make the mash up to 1 day ahead; dredge, fry and make the gravy on the night

steps.text: Peel and boil the potatoes until soft, then mash with the butter and some of the milk. Keep warm.
Press the mushroom clusters flat with your hand and season the flour with salt and plenty of cracked peppercorns.
Dredge each cluster in flour, then buttermilk, then flour again.
Shallow fry in hot oil until deep golden and crisp, then keep warm on a rack.
Whisk the gravy flour into a little of the pan oil, add the remaining milk and lots of cracked pepper and simmer until thick.
Serve the mushrooms over the mash with the gravy.

dishes.make_ahead: Best warm, bake the day you serve

steps.text: Heat the oven to 190C. Slice the peaches and toss with the sugar, cinnamon and lemon juice in a baking dish.
Rub the butter into the flour, then stir in the milk to a thick batter.
Drop spoonfuls of batter over the fruit and bake until golden and bubbling.
Serve warm with scoops of ice cream.

dishes.make_ahead: Tea base up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water with the sliced peaches and sugar for 6 minutes, then remove the bags.
Chill the tea with the peaches in it until very cold.
Fill four tall glasses with ice and add bourbon to each.
Top with tea and finish with a squeeze of lemon, a peach slice and a sprig of mint.

s.note: Raw peanuts simmered in salty Cajun water, served warm in paper cups
s.how: Simmer 500g raw peanuts in the shell for 2 hours in water with 80g salt and 1 tbsp Cajun seasoning. Turn off the heat and soak an hour. Drain and serve warm in paper cups.

s.note: Garlic and dill pickled okra with chilli, served cold with sharp cheddar
s.how: Pack 400g okra into a jar with 3 garlic cloves, dill and a chilli. Pour over 300ml hot white vinegar boiled with 200ml water and 1 tbsp salt. Pickle a week. Serve cold with 200g sharp cheddar.

m.note: Crisp breaded steak under creamy black pepper gravy
m.how: Pound 4 minute steaks thin. Dredge in seasoned flour, then buttermilk, then flour again and fry until crisp. Whisk 2 tbsp flour into the pan fat, add 400ml milk and lots of cracked pepper and simmer. Serve over mash.

w.note: Cinnamon peaches under a soft biscuit topping, with vanilla ice cream
w.how: Toss 6 sliced peaches with 80g brown sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and lemon juice. Rub 80g butter into 200g self-raising flour, add 150ml milk and drop over the fruit. Bake at 190C for 40 minutes. Serve with vanilla ice cream.

d.note: Sweet black tea with peaches and a shot of bourbon over ice
d.how: Brew 5 black tea bags in 1L boiling water with 2 sliced peaches and 100g sugar for 6 minutes. Remove the bags and chill with the peaches in. Fill four tall glasses with ice, add 30ml bourbon to each, then top with the tea. Finish each with a squeeze of lemon, a peach slice and a sprig of mint.
